definition_zh: 偏爱；优先；优待；优先权
definition_en: the choosing of one thing over another, or the right to be served or paid before others
core_image: 一只盘子里的两块点心本一模一样，拿筷子的人却每次都先夹靠左那一块，动作快得像是早已决定
scene: 早上七点，车站售票窗口前拉起了两列队伍，戴徽章的工作人员把一侧的人先引到柜台前。Give your preference to families with small children when seats are limited.
sceneCN: 这里本词指优先安排或优先照顾（第 2 个义项：把先办、先得的次序给别人）；句意为座位有限时优先安排带幼儿的家庭；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 偏爱；更喜欢的事物（可数或不可数）

derivatives.zh: 去掉名词后缀，回到同族动词，语义偏移为「更喜欢；宁愿」
由本词加表关系的形容词后缀构成，语义偏移为「优先的；优待的」
由同族形容词加表方式的副词后缀构成，语义偏移为「最好是」
由同族动词加表「可……的」后缀构成，语义偏移为「更可取的」
由本词加表股份的名词构成，语义偏移为「优先股」

senses.title: Liking one thing more
senses.definition: a stronger liking for one thing than for another
senses.definitionCN: 对某物的喜欢超过对另一物的喜欢
senses.example: Her preference is for strong tea rather than coffee.
senses.exampleCN: 她偏爱浓茶而非咖啡。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to carry a thing in front; what is put in front is what one favours.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为把某物搬到前面；被放到前面，就是被偏爱的。

senses.title: The right to be served first
senses.definition: the right or practice of being dealt with before others
senses.definitionCN: 先于他人得到办理或照顾的权利或做法
senses.example: Give your preference to families with small children when seats are limited.
senses.exampleCN: 座位有限时优先安排带幼儿的家庭。
senses.why: Being placed before others is a literal carrying forward, so the noun marks rank as well as taste.
senses.whyCN: 被放在他人之前，正是字面意义上的搬到前面，因此该名词也标出次序。

senses.title: A trade advantage
senses.definition: a lower tariff or easier terms granted to certain trading partners
senses.definitionCN: 给予某些贸易伙伴的较低关税或更宽条件
senses.example: The agreement grants tariff preference to the smallest exporters.
senses.exampleCN: 该协议给予最小规模的出口商关税优惠。
senses.why: A partner carried to the front of the queue is a partner who pays less at the border.
senses.whyCN: 被提到队伍前面的伙伴，就是在关境上付款更少的伙伴。

senses.title: A first claim in law
senses.definition: the right of one creditor to be paid before others from a debtor's property
senses.definitionCN: 某一债权人从债务人财产中先于他人受偿的权利
senses.example: The bank's preference over the land was recorded at the registry.
senses.exampleCN: 银行对这块地的优先受偿权已在登记处记录。
senses.why: Law keeps the order of payment literal: one claim is carried ahead of the rest.
senses.whyCN: 法律把付款次序说得很字面：一项债权被搬到其余债权之前。

senses.title: One's first choice
senses.definition: the person or thing one would choose first if only one could be had
senses.definitionCN: 若只能得到一个，会最先选择的人或物
senses.example: This route is our preference for the crossing.
senses.exampleCN: 这条路线是我们过河的首选。
senses.why: Choosing is ranking, and the top of the ranking is what stands in front.
senses.whyCN: 选择就是排序，排在最前面的那一个就是被放到前面的。

senses.title: Settings stored by software
senses.definition: stored choices that tell a program how its user wants it to behave
senses.definitionCN: 程序记录下来的、说明用户希望它如何运作的选择
senses.example: The app keeps your preference even after you sign out.
senses.exampleCN: 即使退出登录，这款应用仍保留你的偏好设置。
senses.why: A machine that remembers a choice keeps a small record of what its user put first.
senses.whyCN: 会记住选择机器，就是留下用户「把什么放在前面」的小记录。

senses.title: A pattern in buying
senses.definition: the tendency of buyers to favour certain goods, brands or features
senses.definitionCN: 购买者更偏爱某些商品、品牌或特性的趋势
senses.example: Surveys track preference for local produce.
senses.exampleCN: 调查追踪消费者对本地农产品的偏好。
senses.why: Economists widen one person's taste into a measurable pattern of favouring.
senses.whyCN: 经济学家把一个人的口味扩展成可测量的偏爱模式。

senses.title: A taste shaped by culture
senses.definition: a leaning in style, art or custom that a group learns rather than inherits
senses.definitionCN: 群体习得而非天生继承的风格、艺术或习俗上的偏向
senses.example: Colour preference varies sharply between regions.
senses.exampleCN: 颜色偏好在不同地区差别很大。
senses.why: Shared leaning is still a carrying forward of one option, only now by a whole group.
senses.whyCN: 共享的偏向仍然是「把某一选项搬到前面」，只是搬运者换成了一个群体。

intro.en: Preference comes from Latin praeferre 'to carry in front, place before', built from prae- 'before' and ferre 'to carry'; English took it through French.
intro.cn: 本词来自拉丁语 praeferre「搬到前面、置于前面」，由表「在前」的前缀加 ferre「携带」构成；英语经法语借入。

items.en: Ferre meant 'to carry, bear, bring', one of the most common verbs of movement in Latin.
items.cn: ferre 意为「携带、承载、带来」，是拉丁语中最常见的移动动词之一。

items.en: Prae- meant 'before, in front', whether of place or of rank.
items.cn: 表「在前」的前缀意为在位置上或次序上靠前。

items.en: Praeferre joined the two: to carry something in front of something else, hence to set one above another.
items.cn: 两相结合构成的动词意为把某物搬到另一物之前，因此引申为把某物排到另一物之上。

items.en: French made a noun of the verb, and English borrowed it in the fourteenth century for the act of favouring.
items.cn: 法语把该动词名词化，英语在十四世纪借入，指偏爱的行为。

items.en: Courts and merchants narrowed the noun to a right of first payment and a lower tariff.
items.cn: 法庭与商人把该名词收窄为先受偿的权利与更低的关税。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper root): the earliest English use is placed in the fourteenth century, and the older base behind ferre is generally considered a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词源）：英语最早书证定于十四世纪，而 ferre 背后的更早词基一般认为是重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds words that look or sound close and are often confused with this noun; group two holds words for choosing and for liking.
note.cn: 第一组是与本词形近或音近、常被混淆的词；第二组是表示选择与喜爱的词。

entries.definition: The base verb meaning to like one thing better; the noun adds the result of that liking.
entries.definitionCN: 基干动词，意为更喜欢某物；名词则加出这种喜爱的结果。

entries.definition: The adjective built on this noun, describing treatment that gives someone first place.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词构成的形容词，描述给予某人优先地位的处理方式。

entries.definition: A noun for advancement in office, from the same verb but with a different sense.
entries.definitionCN: 同出该动词，但指职位上的升迁，义项不同。

entries.definition: An adjective saying one option is better; it evaluates rather than records a taste.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，表示某个选项更好；它作评价，而不记录口味。

entries.definition: The act of picking or the set of options; preference is the leaning that guides the pick.
entries.definitionCN: 挑选的动作或可选范围；本词是引导挑选的那种偏向。

entries.definition: Simple fondness for something, without the sense of ranking one above another.
entries.definitionCN: 对某物的朴素喜爱，不含把某物排在另一物之上的意味。

entries.definition: The state of coming first because of urgency or importance, a matter of order rather than taste.
entries.definitionCN: 因紧急或重要而排在最前，讲的是次序而非口味。

entries.definition: A favourable condition or benefit; the trade sense of preference is one kind of advantage.
entries.definitionCN: 有利条件或好处；本词的贸易义是其中一种。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Two real parts: a prefix meaning before, and a verb meaning to carry.
normal.cn: 两个真实成分：一个表「在前」的前缀，加一个表「携带」的动词。

normal.en: The family runs prefer, preference, preferable, preferably, preferential.
normal.cn: 同族词包括更喜欢、偏爱、更可取的、最好是、优先的。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: have a preference for, give preference to, in preference to.
normal.cn: 固定说法：偏爱、优先考虑、优先于。

normal.en: Every technical use puts somebody at the front: a creditor, an exporter, a passenger, a setting.
normal.cn: 每个专业用法都把某一方放到前面：债权人、出口商、乘客、某项设置。

normal.en: The noun records a ranking; the verb records the act of ranking.
normal.cn: 名词记录的是排序结果，动词记录的是排序的动作。

abstract.en: Picture two identical cakes on a plate and a hand that always reaches left first.
abstract.cn: 想象盘里两块一模一样的点心，一只手每次都先伸向左边。

abstract.en: Picture a rope laid across a queue to mark who is let through first.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绳子横在队伍中，标出谁先被放行。

abstract.en: Picture a screen that remembers which button you press every morning.
abstract.cn: 想象一块屏幕记住了你每天早上按的那个按钮。

examples.en: He has a strong preference for quiet rooms.
examples.cn: 他非常偏爱安静的房间。

examples.en: Preference was given to applicants from the region.
examples.cn: 优先考虑了来自本地区的申请人。

examples.en: You can change your preference at any time.
examples.cn: 你随时可以更改自己的偏好设置。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把「在前」与「携带」合起来看：把某样东西搬到前面，就是偏爱它、优先待它。

root: 拉丁 praeferre「搬到前面、置于前面」＝表「在前」的前缀＋ferre「携带」；英语经法语借入，由「置于前」引申为偏爱与优先；更深词基一般认为是重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one move: an object carried to the front is the one liked, served first, taxed less, paid first, chosen first, remembered by a machine, favoured by buyers and shaped by a culture.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：被搬到前面的东西，就是被偏爱的、先被服务的、少缴税的、先受偿的、首选中的、被机器记住的、被买家青睐的、被文化塑造的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two identical cakes on a plate, and a hand that always reaches for the left one first.
core.cn: 核心意象：盘里两块一模一样的点心，一只手每次都先伸向左边的。

branches.en: TASTE AND CULTURE: one person's liking and a region's shared style are the same favouring at two scales.
branches.cn: 口味与文化：一个人的喜爱与一个地区共享的风格，是同一种偏爱在两个尺度上。

branches.en: RANK AND TRADE: being served before others and paying less at the border both mean being moved ahead.
branches.cn: 次序与贸易：先被服务与在关境少缴税，都意味着被移到前面。

branches.en: THE LEGAL CLAIM: a creditor carried ahead of the rest keeps the image in strict order.
branches.cn: 法律的求偿：被搬到其余人之前的债权人，把这意象保持在严格次序里。

branches.en: THE FIRST CHOICE: what one would pick first stands at the head of a ranking.
branches.cn: 首选：最先会挑的那个，排在名单的最前。

branches.en: MACHINE AND MARKET: a stored setting and a buyer's pattern both record what is put first.
branches.cn: 机器与市场：存下的设置与买家的模式，都记录「什么被放在前面」。

intro.en: Preference is a Latin noun formed from a prefix, a carrying verb and a noun suffix; the same pieces build a small English family, so the word can be read in parts.
intro.cn: 本词是由表方向的前缀、表「携带」的动词与名词后缀构成的拉丁名词；同样的部件构成一个小英语词族，可按部分读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin prae- supplies 'before' and ferre supplies 'carry'; the noun suffix names the act, and English adds nothing further.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语表「在前」的前缀提供「之前」之义，表「携带」的动词提供搬运义，名词后缀命名这一行为；英语不再加缀。

items.example: The verb is the carrying itself.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词就是「搬」这个动作本身。

items.meaning: to carry in front, to set above
items.example: To carry a thing in front is to give it the first place.
items.exampleCN: 把东西搬到前面，就是给它第一位。

items.example: The state noun named the favouring.
items.exampleCN: 这个状态名词命名偏爱。

items.meaning: a liking, or a right to come first
items.example: Her preference is for the coast road.
Bring a map, preferably a paper one.
items.exampleCN: 带张地图，最好是纸质的。
这家公司赢得了优待条件。

items.meaning: a share paid before ordinary shares
